body.x: Good Life (CEO Lee Jong-ho) willparticipate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening inLas Vegas on Jan. 7-10 and will display its power outlet with new concept SO(Safe Outlets) in CES startup zone Eureka Park MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT with thesupport from Changwon Industry Promotion Agency.
SO was developed to fundamentally solve the big problem of existing outlets such as electric shock, short circuit, and fire.

SO uses the principle that the water flowing into the outlet does not enter the inside and is discarded directly through the drain pipe separated by electric polarity. So, it can be used safely even when water is poured in the electric outlet.

Other power outlets have the problem of electric shock and short-circuit caused by the process of inserting and removing the plugs and getting foreign materials in them. But SO completely blocks the electricity before inserting the plug completely, so it never causes electric shock or short-circuit.

CEO Lee said, "This technology is thesame size and shape of existing outlets, but can be applied to all 14 outletsworldwide. We look forward to collaboration, patent transfers, royaltyrevenues, and entry into the US, Europe and emerging markets in Southeast Asia.”

AVING NEWS, the media that has made themost promotion of Korean companies, has set up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT in CES2020 Startup Zone EUREKA PARK as the project to help Korean startups to enterthe global market, and will introduce the major Korean startups to the world.

By using the strengths of CES, AVING NEWSplans to inform investors, buyers and media Korea’s promising startups throughvarious programs such as strategic consulting, PR marketing, and networkingparties. MIK Zone is hosted by Next Generation ConvergenceContents Industry Association, AVING NEWS, and MD Insight, and organized byBluefoot. It is participated by Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, IncheonTechno Park Startup Support Center, Gwangju University Startup Support Group,and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group.
